item.title: Week 11: Saints at Bears
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CHI -11.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CHI 85% vs. market 84% | New Orleans must manufacture chunk plays, because its 7.2% explosive rate meets a Chicago defense that allows 8.9%, and that collision will likely decide the game. Chris Olave commands 42% of New Orleans' air yards, and he will run into a Chicago pass defense ranked 11th. Our model puts Chicago at 85% against a market price of 84%, and the rushing matchup supplies most of the gap.
